name: subagent-watch
description: Use when you started subagents with spawn_run and must watch them until they finish without the wait tool. Runs a script that checks every N seconds for M rounds and reports each run as running, done or waiting for approval.
title: Watch subagents
goal: Check on running subagents in a loop that lives in a script, so the model does not spend a turn per check and never needs the wait tool.
steps: Test once per session: `python3 {{skill_dir}}/scripts/watch_subagents.py --probe`. Exit 0 means the shell can reach Crew.

Watch: `python3 {{skill_dir}}/scripts/watch_subagents.py --every 30 --rounds 10 ID1 ID2` (the ids come from the spawn_run reply). It prints one line per round and returns when every run is done or the rounds are used up.
Exit codes: 0 all done, 3 rounds used up and some run still going, 4 a run waits for spawn approval in the dashboard, 5 an id is not in the list, 2 Crew cannot be reached from this shell.
Keep one call under the shell tool's time limit: --every times --rounds should stay under a few minutes. Repeat the call to keep watching.
output: The script's lines, and what they mean for the user.
gotchas: It only reads the list of runs (`kirocrew spawn list`); it never changes or stops a run.
A run that finishes can drop out of the list after about an hour; check right after the completion event.
